resources.string: A world of strategy, ready for touch
The first launch prepares the included campaigns and music. No extra download is needed.
This action is not available right now.
Finish your turn? Units with moves remaining will wait until your next turn.
Return to the main menu? Save your game first to keep your latest progress.

Tap your unit, then tap a destination to preview the route. Press Move / attack to move there. To attack, tap a reachable enemy and press Move / attack; you can review weapons and odds before committing.

Tap your selected unit again to deselect it, then drag to explore the map. Use Zoom + and Zoom − for a closer view. Long press a hex for its context menu.

Next unit finds another unit. Recruit opens recruitment when available. Undo reverses moves when the game allows it. End turn asks before finishing.

Hide collapses this bar to give the map more space. More contains objectives, saves, unit information, and preferences.
